name: Adyen
label: Adyen — Adyen Checkout v72
description: Official Adyen Checkout v72. Docs: https://docs.adyen.com/api-explorer/Checkout/72/overview. One node; operations via `operation`. operation=trigger is kind:ingress — it does not open a socket. Use a BPMN message start / catch / boundary event; StudioQuack webhook ingress correlates onto those events. There is no Webhook node. HARD PCI: cardholder data never enters the graph. Use processor tokens (pm_, nonce, encryptedCard, vault id) only. Never PAN, CVC, track data, or raw bank account numbers on INPUT/OUTPUT/logs. API keys are StudioQuack password secrets. DO NOT BUILD catalog payout on this host (Transfers API is a different base). Live Checkout uses {PREFIX}-checkout-live.adyenpayments.com/checkout/v72. paymentMethod = encrypted card / token / storedPaymentMethodId only. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields for Adyen. Secrets never on this port. HARD PCI: cardholder data never enters the graph. Use processor tokens (pm_, nonce, encryptedCard, vault id) only. Never PAN, CVC, track data, or raw bank account numbers on INPUT/OUTPUT/logs. API keys are StudioQuack password secrets.

schema.label: Operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation. EXACT: payment_create | payment_capture | payment_refund | trigger. trigger is ingress (BPMN message event), not HTTP.

schema.label: amount
schema.description: Adyen Amount envelope escape hatch {value, currency}. Purpose fields value/currency merge as amount.* via bodyMap. Example: {"value":1000,"currency":"USD"}.

schema.label: value
schema.description: Amount in minor units on payment_create/capture/refund. Nested as amount.value. Example: 1000 (=$10.00 USD).

schema.label: currency
schema.description: ISO-4217 currency on payment_create/capture/refund. Nested as amount.currency. Example: USD.

schema.label: reference
schema.description: Merchant reference for payment_create. Example: order-42.

schema.label: merchantAccount
schema.description: Adyen merchantAccount for payment_create / capture / refund. Example: YOUR_MERCHANT_ACCOUNT.

schema.label: paymentMethod
schema.description: paymentMethod object for payment_create. Example: {"type":"scheme","encryptedCardNumber":"..."}. Never log PAN/CVC.

schema.label: pspReference
schema.description: PSP reference path for payment_capture / payment_refund. Example: 8535296650153317.

schema.label: returnUrl
schema.description: URL the shopper is redirected to after payment_create. Example: https://example.com/return.

schema.label: shopperReference
schema.description: Your shopper id for payment_create (tokenisation / stored details). Example: shopper-42.

schema.label: shopperEmail
schema.description: Shopper email for payment_create. Example: ada@example.com.

schema.label: countryCode
schema.description: ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 shopper country for payment_create. Example: NL.

schema.label: channel
schema.description: payment_create channel. EXACT: iOS | Android | Web. Example: Web.

schema.label: Live Url Prefix
schema.description: Company-specific live Checkout host prefix. Live base: https://{live_url_prefix}-checkout-live.adyenpayments.com/checkout/v72. Leave blank for test (checkout-test.adyen.com).

ports.name: output
ports.description: OfficialApiNode result: {status,http_status,data}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body. Never secrets or PAN.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: HTTP verb to run. EXACT: payment_create | payment_capture | payment_refund | trigger. Default payment_create. operation=trigger is kind:ingress — it does not open a socket. Use a BPMN message start / catch / boundary event; StudioQuack webhook ingress correlates onto those events. There is no Webhook node.

configurationParameters.label: Api Key
configurationParameters.description: Adyen credential (header X-API-Key). StudioQuack secret. Never INPUT, never logged.

configurationParameters.label: Merchant Account
configurationParameters.description: Default Adyen merchantAccount when INPUT merchantAccount is empty.

configurationParameters.label: Live Url Prefix
configurationParameters.description: Live Checkout URL prefix (company-specific). Empty = test endpoint checkout-test.adyen.com.
